ancient_dragon_fish_wipe_the_green_so_th: Wall clear. It glowed twice as bright to say thanks.
Cleaned the window. The legend grants no review.
ancient_dragon_fish_peer_for_a_loose_jew: Every scale in place. It must have a good lawyer.
A thousand jewels, none loose. Better kept than my feathers.
ancient_dragon_fish_fling_a_tribute_of_f: A tribute to a legend: flakes and a bad pun.
Flakes up over the wall. The legend is not above supper.
ancient_dragon_fish_press_a_flake_to_the: Whiskers first, then the mouth. It tastes by touch.
One flake, a lot of ceremony.
ancient_dragon_fish_unwind_the_serpent_w: Unwound it yard by glowing yard. Longer than the wall.
It followed the wingtip without hurry. Plenty to hurry about.
ancient_dragon_fish_dangle_a_flake_for_t: Rose from the dark, took the flake, left the dark in my head.
It surfaced like a lamp coming on.
ancient_dragon_fish_race_its_tail_down_t: Ran the wall's length. The tail was still on the other side of the sign.
Still not at the tail. It has a second tail.
ancient_dragon_fish_pace_out_its_length_: Twenty-three paces and the tail was still unfinished. Legends are poor for stock-taking.
A whole wall of serpent. The measure is mostly in the awe.
ancient_dragon_fish_bow_to_the_old_lamp_: Bowed. It drifted past. The entire tank went green with approval.
A duck bows to a legend. It glows twice as long.
ancient_dragon_fish_argue_which_of_them_: I am the younger legend. By about a thousand years.
Lost to a fish with scales like gems. I have feathers.
ancient_dragon_fish_sing_the_serpent_an_: It flickered on the chorus. My favourite review.
Sang a lullaby to a thing that could swallow the sea. It listened.
ancient_dragon_fish_jump_back_when_the_g: White-out. I was a duck in a flashbulb.
Eyes are still green. The serpent chuckled, probably.
ancient_dragon_fish_hold_the_serpent_bet: Both ends held. The middle is the part nobody is holding.
Two ducks, one serpent, a strange knot of respect.
ancient_dragon_fish_trade_gong_beats_bet: Left, right, glow. A very slow ping-pong.
A call, an answer, a long luminous silence.
ancient_dragon_fish_sing_a_round_with_a_: Off by a whole bar and the fish loved it.
A round sung to the deep. It came back around.
ancient_dragon_fish_thread_the_glow_thro: Through the ring, all of it, and the ring did not blink.
The hoop is now a halo. I decline credit.

ancient_dragon_fish_wipe_the_green_so_th.label: Wiping the green film off the wall in slow curved strokes so the serpent's glow shows true, the wing moving like a lantern-tender

ancient_dragon_fish_polish_a_lens_in_the.label: Polishing a clear lens in the wall at chest height with small circles so every scale's glow can be seen through it

ancient_dragon_fish_peer_for_a_loose_jew.label: Peering along the serpent's glowing flank for any loose or missing scale as it unrolls past the wall

ancient_dragon_fish_shoo_the_leaf_shadow.label: Brushing the shadow of floating leaves off the wall with the tip of a wing where the glow should fall

ancient_dragon_fish_tap_the_pier_post_fo.label: Tapping the left pier post slowly with his bill, a gong beat that carries along the dark and brings the serpent unwinding

ancient_dragon_fish_fling_a_tribute_of_f.label: Flinging a tribute of flakes up over the coping into the dark like an offering, the serpent's light rising slowly to meet them

ancient_dragon_fish_press_a_flake_to_the.label: Pressing one flake to the wall with his bill, the long whiskers drifting against the other side to find it

ancient_dragon_fish_unwind_the_serpent_w.label: Drawing a wingtip slowly along the wall so the tightly wound serpent unwinds a coil at a time and glides after it

ancient_dragon_fish_pat_the_wall_at_the_.label: Patting the wall with the back of a wing where the great brow rests, slow strokes like soothing a very large cat

ancient_dragon_fish_dangle_a_flake_for_t.label: Dangling a flake on a reed over the coping until the serpent rolls all the way up the wall to claim it, lit from within

ancient_dragon_fish_race_its_tail_down_t.label: Racing the tail of the serpent down the wall, running the whole length and finding there is more serpent than wall

ancient_dragon_fish_step_a_slow_dance_in.label: Stepping a slow solo dance at the front lip in the dark, every move made a beat after the serpent's shimmer

ancient_dragon_fish_look_for_the_serpent.label: Hunting along the wall for the serpent by following the faint glow it leaves in the dark, bill dipping at each smudge

ancient_dragon_fish_balance_a_flake_on_h.label: Carrying a flake at the tip of his bill and swaying along the wall so the serpent trails the flake in a long glittering line

ancient_dragon_fish_hop_the_ledge_in_tim.label: Hopping the ledge in time with the flicker of its scales, one hop for each ripple of light that runs down its length

ancient_dragon_fish_count_the_jewel_scal.label: Counting the jewel scales on one flank with a bill dip each, giving up when the whole flank starts to flicker

ancient_dragon_fish_read_the_sign_by_its.label: Reading the tank sign by the serpent's glow alone, going close and then far to find where the letters fade

ancient_dragon_fish_listen_for_the_low_h.label: Listening with his head against the left pier post for the low hum the old serpent makes in the dark

ancient_dragon_fish_doze_off_in_the_gree.label: Dozing off on the left ledge in the green light of its glow, bill on his chest, the wall shivering with light

ancient_dragon_fish_sit_at_the_lip_and_w.label: Sitting at the front lip with his feet tucked, watching the long body wind and unwind in the dark like a ribbon

ancient_dragon_fish_wait_for_the_first_g.label: Waiting stock-still by the wall at dusk for the first glimmer along the dark to wake

ancient_dragon_fish_lean_on_the_right_po.label: Leaning on the right pier post with his chin on a wing, gazing at the slow river of light along the wall

ancient_dragon_fish_sulk_when_the_glow_s.label: Sulking at the dark wall with his back to the water because the old serpent has not lit up for anyone all night

ancient_dragon_fish_wrap_both_wings_roun.label: Wrapping both wings round himself against the cold night, bill tucked, the only warm thing a glowing fish ahead

ancient_dragon_fish_scoop_the_ice_plates.label: Scooping the thin plates of ice off the top of the tank with a reed held out over the coping so the glow can breathe

ancient_dragon_fish_wipe_the_frost_flowe.label: Wiping the frost flowers off the clear lens in the wall with a quick wing so the light can come through

ancient_dragon_fish_shelter_with_a_wing_.label: Sheltering low on the left ledge with a wing over his head while the rain freckles the tank and the serpent glows right through it

ancient_dragon_fish_straighten_every_fea.label: Straightening every ruffled feather after a gust, preening wing to chest to tail in order, the glow for a mirror

ancient_dragon_fish_bow_to_the_old_lamp_.label: Bowing low to the old lamp of the deep as its head glides up to the wall, a long respectful dip with the bill nearly touching

ancient_dragon_fish_present_the_serpent_.label: Presenting the serpent to the night sky with a sweeping arc of the wing along the whole wall, an usher for a legend

ancient_dragon_fish_pose_in_the_green_li.label: Posing on the right ledge as a statue in the green light, one wing on his chest and the other pointed at the stars

ancient_dragon_fish_sing_the_serpent_an_.label: Singing the serpent an old lullaby in a low voice, slow and wobbly, while its glow pulses to the long notes

ancient_dragon_fish_slip_on_the_ledge_in.label: Slipping on the unseen wet patch of the ledge in the dark, feet out front, and clutching the wall on the way down

ancient_dragon_fish_bump_the_wall_starin.label: Staring up at the glow as it curls over the sign and bumping the wall hard with his bill

ancient_dragon_fish_jump_back_when_the_g.label: Jumping back with a yelp when the whole serpent flares white right at his bill, the wall lit like a lightning strike
